Misali: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Don tsallake haruffan sarrafawa guda (' \/), za ka iya amfani da \. Misali: Field1 == I\'m. Haka kuma za ka iya haɗa sharuɗɗa da yawa. Misali: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. A al'ada ana fassara duk alamomin daga hagu zuwa dama. Za ka iya sauya jeri ta amfani da baka. Misali: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). globalSearch-instructions-description: Bincike na iya ƙunsar masu aiki don takaita binciken. Ana bayyana masu aiki ta rubuta sunan mai aiki da ƙimarsa, waƙafi mai ɗigo ya raba su. Misali, bayanin mai aiki `jeri:An-toshe` zai takaita binciken zuwa katunan da ke cikin jeri mai suna *An-toshe*. Idan ƙimar tana da sarari ko haruffa na musamman dole a sanya ta cikin alamomin zance (misali `__operator_list__:"A Duba"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operators: Masu aiki da ake da su:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - katunan cikin allunan da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - katunan cikin jerin da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - katunan cikin layukan iyo da suka dace da *<title>* da aka bayyana
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - katunan da ke da sharhi mai ɗauke da *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - katunan da ke da alamar da ta dace da *<color>* ko *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* yake *mamba* ko *wanda aka sanya wa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-assig: `__operator_assignee__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* yake *wanda aka sanya wa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - katunan da *<username>* shi ne mai ƙirƙirar katin
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - katunan da ke cikin allo da aka sanya wa ƙungiya *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - katunan da ke cikin allo da aka sanya wa tawaga *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - katunan da wa'adinsu zai yi cikin kwanaki *<n>* daga yanzu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ yana lissafa dukkan katunan da ranar ƙarewarsu ta wuce.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - katunan da aka ƙirƙira kwanaki *<n>* da suka wuce ko ƙasa da haka
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - katunan da aka gyara kwanaki *<n>* da suka wuce ko ƙasa da haka
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - inda *<status>* yake ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dukkan katunan da aka adana da waɗanda ba a adana ba
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - katunan da ke da ranar ƙarshe
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - katuna a alluna masu zaman kansu kawai
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - inda *<field>* yake ɗaya daga `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` ko `__predicate_member__`. Sanya `-` a gaban *<field>* yana binciken rashin ƙima a wannan fili (misali `has:-due` yana binciken katunan da ba su da ranar ƙarewa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - inda *<sort-name>* yake ɗaya daga `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` ko `__predicate_modified__`. Don jeri mai gangarowa, sanya `-` a gaban sunan jeri.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - inda *<n>* yake cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya da ke bayyana yawan katunan da za a nuna a kowane shafi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Ana iya bayyana masu aiki da yawa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ana haɗa masu aiki iri ɗaya da *OR*. Za a dawo da katunan da suka dace da kowane ɗaya daga sharuɗɗan.
`__operator_list__:Akwai __operator_list__:An-toshe` zai dawo da katunan da ke cikin kowane jeri mai suna *An-toshe* ko *Akwai*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ana haɗa masu aiki mabambanta da *AND*. Katunan da suka dace da dukkan masu aikin mabambanta kawai ake dawo da su. `__operator_list__:Akwai __operator_label__:ja` yana dawo da katunan cikin jerin *Akwai* masu alamar *ja* kawai.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Ana iya bayyana kwanaki da cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya ko marar tabbas, ko ta amfani da `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` ko `__predicate_year__` don zangon yanzu.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Binciken rubutu ba ya bambanta manyan da ƙananan haruffa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: A tsoho ba a bincika katunan da aka adana.

A tsoho yana kashe, don haka ana nuna markdown yadda aka saba.

disable-import-avatars-description: Idan an kunna, ba a taɓa shigo da hotunan fuska (hotunan bayanin mai amfani) ba. Har yanzu ana shigo da sunaye da sauran bayanai; hotunan fuska kawai ake tsallakewa. A tsoho yana kashe.

Idan ana aikawa, sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba. Ba za a iya janye saƙon da ake aikawa ba, kuma ana iya maimaita isarwar da ba a tabbatar da ita ba. Rashin nasara na dindindin da ƙoƙarin da ya kai iyakar sake gwadawa suna nan don dubawa. Sake gwada saƙonnin da suka gaza yana fara sabon zagayen ƙoƙari kuma yana kiyaye dakatarwar da take akwai.

rule-email-resolution-busy: Wani mai gudanarwa yana yanke shawara kan wannan imel. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imel ɗin da aka adana bai ƙara dacewa da wannan yunƙurin ba, don haka ba za a iya yanke shawara a kansa a nan ba.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Bayanan wannan yunƙurin da aka adana ba su da inganci, don haka ba za a iya yanke shawara a kansa a nan ba.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ba a iya yanke shawara kan wannan imel ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa
rule-email-legacy-description: Wata tsohuwar sigar WeKan ce ta shirya waɗannan imel na ƙa'idoji ba tare da rubuta inda abubuwan da ke cikinsu suka fito ba, don haka WeKan ba zai aika su da kansa ba. Bayan ka tabbatar cewa marubucin ƙa'idar har yanzu yana da damar shiga, sake haɗa imel domin a sake shirya shi daga halin katin na yanzu, ko ka watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: A sake shirya wannan imel daga halin katin na yanzu? Abubuwan da ke cikinsa na iya bambanta da waɗanda aka shirya a baya.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: A watsar da wannan imel? Ba za a taɓa aika shi ba.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Babu imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ba a iya loda imel na ƙa'idoji masu jiran dubawa ba. Sabunta shafin don sake gwadawa.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Marubucin ƙa'idar ba shi da damar shiga wannan kati yanzu, ko ƙa'idar ta canza, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa imel ɗin ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Aikin da ya jawo wannan imel ya canza, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Katin da wannan imel ya fito daga gare shi ba ya samuwa yanzu, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ba a ƙara adana bayanan gudanar da ƙa'idar da ta shirya wannan imel ba, don haka ba za a iya sake haɗa shi ba. Za ka iya watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: An riga an aika wannan imel, an yi yunƙurin aikawa ko an watsar da shi.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: An riga an sake haɗa wannan imel.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ba a iya kammala wannan aiki ba. Sabunta shafin ka sake gwadawa.
saml-login-not-started: Ba a fara wannan shiga ta SAML a wannan shafin burauzar ba. Da fatan za a sake shiga.
history-request-pending-undo: Sabar ba ta tabbatar da sokewar canjinka na ƙarshe ba tukuna.
history-request-pending-redo: Sabar ba ta tabbatar da sake aiwatar da canjinka na ƙarshe ba tukuna.
history-request-hint: Sake gwadawa yana maimaita buƙatar ɗaya, don haka ba zai taɓa soke canji na biyu ba.
